AdvisoryItem.description: ML advisory placeholder. Step 10 fills this; Step 9 keeps it empty.
AdvisoryItem.title: AdvisoryItem

AnalysisRun.description: Identity record for one analysis of one capture.
AnalysisRun.title: AnalysisRun

ArtifactHash.description: Named content hash. `sha256` is required only when `availability` is present.
ArtifactHash.title: ArtifactHash

Availability.description: Whether a requested provenance field could be populated from evidence.
Availability.title: Availability

ByteRange.description: Half-open `[start, end)` range in relative TCP sequence space.
ByteRange.title: ByteRange

CaptureLimitations.description: Visibility and reconstruction limits that must not be read as a pass.
CaptureLimitations.title: CaptureLimitations

CapturePreflight.description: capinfos facts recorded before any analyzer mutates a working copy.
CapturePreflight.title: CapturePreflight

CertificateEvidence.description: One extracted X.509 certificate. Path/identity live on `validation` for leaves.
CertificateEvidence.title: CertificateEvidence

CertificateRole.description: Whether the certificate was offered by the TLS server or the client.
CertificateRole.title: CertificateRole

CertificateValidation.description: Independent chain and identity outcomes. Attached to server leaves only.

path_invalid_reasons_at_analysis_time.title: Path Invalid Reasons At Analysis Time

path_invalid_reasons_at_capture_time.title: Path Invalid Reasons At Capture Time

CertificateValidation.title: CertificateValidation

CipherSuiteEvidence.description: Selected cipher suite identified by canonical IANA name and hex code.
CipherSuiteEvidence.title: CipherSuiteEvidence

EmailSession.description: Protocol-tagged session with independent port and payload fields.
EmailSession.title: EmailSession

EventSource.description: Analyzer that produced a protocol observation.
EventSource.title: EventSource

EvidenceDocument.description: v2 canonical JSON envelope produced by `securemail analyze`.
EvidenceDocument.title: EvidenceDocument

EvidenceReference.description: Canonical pointer at a contributing evidence field. No JSON array indexes.
EvidenceReference.title: EvidenceReference

EvidenceState.description: Mandatory visibility/confidence state for every applicable evidence field.
EvidenceState.title: EvidenceState

ExplicitUpgrade.description: STARTTLS/STLS assessment. `downgrade_consistent` is never proof of attack.
ExplicitUpgrade.title: ExplicitUpgrade

Finding.description: Deterministic policy judgment. Never mutates the underlying evidence.
Finding.title: Finding

FindingOutcome.description: Serialized policy outcomes. Pass/present results are not emitted as findings.
FindingOutcome.title: FindingOutcome

Flow.description: Canonical per-connection evidence derived from Zeek `conn.log` plus recon facts.
Flow.title: Flow

FontResource.description: Pinned bundled font used by HTML and PDF presentation.
FontResource.title: FontResource

HandshakeMessage.description: One evidence-linked handshake or record message.
HandshakeMessage.title: HandshakeMessage

HandshakeMessageKind.description: Handshake/record kinds reconstructed from Zeek `ssl_history` letters.
HandshakeMessageKind.title: HandshakeMessageKind

HandshakeSignatureEvidence.description: TLS handshake CertificateVerify signature algorithm, not the X.509 cert signature.
HandshakeSignatureEvidence.title: HandshakeSignatureEvidence

HandshakeVisibility.description: How much of the handshake is passively visible.
HandshakeVisibility.title: HandshakeVisibility

ImplicitTls.description: Implicit-TLS correlation. Port alone never sets `correlated_protocol`.
ImplicitTls.title: ImplicitTls

KeyExchangeEvidence.description: Version-aware key-exchange classification. No weakness or FS judgment.
KeyExchangeEvidence.title: KeyExchangeEvidence

ObservedCondition.description: Recoverable transport facts that do not by themselves degrade quality.
ObservedCondition.title: ObservedCondition

OccurrenceRef.description: One contributing session-level finding. Evidence is retained, not dropped.
OccurrenceRef.title: OccurrenceRef

PayloadEvidence.description: Protocol identity derived from payload / analyzer events, not ports.
PayloadEvidence.title: PayloadEvidence

PolicyCheck.description: One applicable policy evaluation. Genuine non-applicability is omitted.
PolicyCheck.title: PolicyCheck

PolicyProfile.description: Built-in Step 7 policy packs. Organization packs are deferred.
PolicyProfile.title: PolicyProfile

PortHint.description: Well-known-port inference only. Never used as protocol proof.
PortHint.title: PortHint

PostureSummary.description: Headline posture copied from `evidence.posture`. Not independently scored.
PostureSummary.title: PostureSummary

ReconstructionReasonCode.description: Machine-readable primary reason when quality is not complete.
ReconstructionReasonCode.title: ReconstructionReasonCode

ReferenceIdentitySource.description: Where the hostname/IP used for identity matching came from.
ReferenceIdentitySource.title: ReferenceIdentitySource

RendererManifest.description: How this JSON is turned into HTML/PDF. Upgrade these pins deliberately.
RendererManifest.title: RendererManifest

RevocationStatus.description: Revocation outcome. Without imported OCSP/CRL evidence this is unknown.
RevocationStatus.title: RevocationStatus

ScoreComponents.description: Hand-computable addends. Sum is the published score (naturally ≤ 100).
ScoreComponents.title: ScoreComponents

ScoredEndpointFinding.description: Prioritized endpoint finding with named score components.
ScoredEndpointFinding.title: ScoredEndpointFinding

SessionEventKind.description: Bounded protocol-event kinds recorded on an `EmailSession`.
SessionEventKind.title: SessionEventKind

SignatureMetadata.description: Detached signing/timestamping is out of Step 9; record unavailability.
SignatureMetadata.title: SignatureMetadata

SourceRecord.description: Identifier for a record the report was assembled from.
SourceRecord.title: SourceRecord

StageError.description: Inspectable stage failure. Empty when the analysis completed.
StageError.title: StageError

TlsHandshake.description: TLS handshake record linked to a `Flow` by Zeek `uid`.
TlsHandshake.title: TlsHandshake

TlsVersionEvidence.description: Negotiated version. `supported_versions` wins over the legacy record version.
TlsVersionEvidence.title: TlsVersionEvidence

VersionSource.description: Where the selected TLS version was taken from. Never ClientHello offers.
VersionSource.title: VersionSource
